profile.headline: Embedded Software Engineer at Apple
profile.summary:
Passionate about all things embedded. 
3 years experience as an embedded engineer.
4 years experience in the automotive industry.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description: Maintain, enhance and debug in house kernel and services

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Created a Test rig for water flow testing
- Wrote firmware to collect data from sensors and send to host computer
- Mocked up and 3d printed many components to connect test rig system

positions.title: SEG intern
positions.description:
- Updated RTOS timer infrastructure to service jobs at a finer granularity.
- Created a PID to control SoC temperatures.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
- Created firmware to poll various sensors and broadcast information on a CAN network.
- Created an embedded linux data acquisition application for an autonomous drone.

positions.title: AUTOSAR integrator
positions.description:
- Designed, developed, tested and deployed AUTOSAR-based embedded software.
- Integrated low-level modules (i.e., RTOS, Watchdog, Ethernet, CAN, CAN-FD) onto single and multi-core chips.
- Modified linker scripts for single and multi-core applications.
- Hosted workshops and gave technical presentations to customers.

positions.title: Lead Research Undergrad
positions.description:
- Developed an in-house, Bluetooth, low-energy stack for a swarm communication bootloader.
- Developed an OTA bootloader to control up to 50 drones simultaneously. bootloader created on NRF52 MCU 
- Created UART DMA, SPI, I2C, ADC, BTLE, QDEC, PWM drivers for NRF52

positions.title: Lead Lab Technician
positions.description:
• Reduced data acquisition system cost while improving performance, robustness and cycle time.
• Conducted laboratory equipment maintenance and calibration.
• Modified PCB’s for proficiency testing, Soldered protortype circuits for testing
• Built wiring harnesses for flashing software and communication.

volunteerExperiences.description: Mentor High school students in the greater Philadelphia area by engaging in group activities

projects.title: SoC Architecture
projects.description: Transferred Software Image processing and compression software to hardware accelerators and GPU's to allow for reduced latency on the application.

projects.title: Rocket Pitch
projects.description:
Working with physical therapist to build a small low power device to monitor pitch count and acceleration of pitches for youth baseball
* developed SPI, ADC, I2C and BTLE drivers for NRF52
* integrated accelerometer for data collection and WINBOND SPI flash chip for data storage
